messages:
lauren: FYI someone left a note on the mini-fridge: "Hummus is communal, label your garlic." Who started lunchtime law school?

ben: guilty. I proposed a simple treaty: label, date, and no surprise cucumber experiments. :fries:

ash: petition to add a Hummus Steward role. Responsibilities: label enforcement, fork census, and emergency pita distribution.

dan: I nominate @ben. He already carries a clipboard.

kate: we should have a tiny flag for approved hummus. Design suggestions? :art:

ash: tricolor: beige (chickpeas), green (herbs), tiny red dot (garlic warning).

ops-bot: Reminder 3 Mar 2026 - Kitchen audit Fri 09:00. Please remove expired items. :warning:

lauren: Also proposal 3 "No-stealth-replacement" rule 3 if you replace someone else's hummus, leave a note and a spare chip.

ben: I accept the stewardship! Will draft the Hummus Accord doc in Confluence and pin to the kitchen board.

kate: I will make the approval flags. Maybe enamel pins?

dan: Adding clause: all hummus must disclose level of garlic on a 1-5 scale.

ash: Can we add a ceremonial spoon? Like, the Spoon of Disclosure. It travels with the flagship container.

lauren: Unanimous. Hummus Accord ratified. Next steps: @ben writes the doc, @kate makes flags, @ash sources ceremonial spoon. If you want to raid or donate hummus this week, drop a note. :salt:

ben: First stewardship task: remove an abandoned jar labeled 2024-07-02. Archaeology day tomorrow.

lauren: Congrats to the new Hummus Steward. This thread closed but the cultural artifact lives on. :tada:
